rules: Section membership is based on current cadet class and valid enrollment context.
One primary section per cadet per applicable academic period.
Section capacity is configured by Academy content/runtime and is not asserted as one canon-wide number.
A section may contain latent slots and materialized cadets simultaneously.
Materializing or interacting with the player does not rebalance a section.
Course or curriculum changes may cause explicit section reassignment.
Being classmates is an institutional/shared-context fact, not proof of friendship or even prior conversation.
